        int[][] dp = new int[n][n * (n - 1) / 2 + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {

                    // This is complex, so let's use a different approach
                    
                    // Instead, let's precompute for each possible first element
                    // But given time, let's use a simpler approach for small n
                }
            }
            
            // Simpler approach: iterate over all pairs of permutations for small n
            if (remaining <= 8) {
                // Generate all permutations of remaining elements
                int[] arr = new int[remaining];
                for (int i = 0; i < remaining; i++) {

                permute(arr, 0, perms);

            } else {

    void permute(int[] arr, int k, List<int[]> result) {
        for (int i = k; i < arr.length; i++) {
            swap(arr, i, k);
            permute(arr, k + 1, result);
            swap(arr, i, k);
        }
        if (k == arr.length - 1) {

    void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {

        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;

    int countInversions(int[] arr) {

    boolean isLexSmaller(int[] a, int[] b) {
